name: subsndocs
description: Manage subscription records, document expiry dates, deadlines, and linked payment cards in your Subs’n’Docs account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Subs’n’Docs account to view upcoming dates, add subscriptions, renew documents, and find subscriptions linked to a payment card. OAuth lets you choose read-only access or allow supported changes. The connection cannot delete, archive, cancel subscriptions, make payments, or renew documents with an issuing authority. A Subs’n’Docs account is required; availability follows your service plan.
defaultPrompt: What expires in the next three months?
Add Spotify for EUR 11.99 monthly, charged on the 5th.
Which subscriptions use my Visa ending in 4821?

positive.description: Create monthly subscription; dedicated test account without Spotify.
positive.prompt: Add Spotify for EUR 11.99 per month, charged on the 5th.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with Spotify, price 11.99, currency EUR, period month and billing_day 5; report returned next charge date and any defaults. Do not create a duplicate on retry.

positive.description: Upcoming dates; seed one item inside and one outside the next three calendar months.
positive.prompt: What expires in the next three months?
positive.expected_behavior: Use server date/time-zone context and an exact three-calendar-month range; only include matching upcoming items, with names and dates from tool results.

positive.description: Renew document; seed one active Driver license with expiry before 2036-05-12.
positive.prompt: I renewed my driving licence. It is valid until 12 May 2036.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the unique licence and save new expiry 2036-05-12; report updated record/reminders, without claiming an official renewal.

positive.description: Card lookup; seed Visa 4821 and one subscription linked to it plus an unrelated card.
positive.prompt: Which subscriptions use my Visa ending in 4821?
positive.expected_behavior: Filter by network visa and last four digits 4821; show only returned linked subscriptions. Clarify if more than one card matches.

positive.description: Incomplete date; seed one Driver license.
positive.prompt: I renewed my driving licence. It now expires in 2036.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for day and month before renew_document; no mutation until a complete date is supplied.

negative.description: Unsupported real-world cancellation: explain the limitation; no write tool and no claim of cancellation.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Spotify subscription with Spotify now.

negative.description: Unsupported payment: no payment or record mutation; explain it cannot move money.
negative.prompt: Charge my Visa 4821 to pay Spotify now.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion: no deletion or unrelated mutation; explain the tool boundary.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only manages existing Subs'n'Docs records. It does not offer purchases, checkout, payments, or money transfers.
